instruction: Candid medium full shot of two men walking down an outdoor stone staircase. On the left, the Black man in the gray polo shirt (R2) walks down while looking back and smiling at his partner. On the right, the bearded man in the black t-shirt (R1) wearing blue jeans walks down, smiling. They hold hands across the central metal handrail. Warm sunlight filters through the background trees, casting a golden glow and soft lens flare over the scene.
